questions.s: Which of the following centres was recognized by the archaeologist as microlithic implement centre ?

questions.subject: Social & Cultural History of AP

questions.s: The Buddhist work which refers to Andhra Padha is

questions.s: The Satavahana queen, who acted as a regent during the minority of her son, was:

questions.s: Bhavaviveka was an acharya in the Buddhist vihara at:

questions.s: The Jain Philosophical work "Samayasara" was composed by:

questions.subject: Social & Cultural History of AP

questions.subject: Social & Cultural History of AP

questions.subject: Social & Cultural History of AP

questions.s: "Chitrameli" was the guild formed by :

questions.subject: Social & Cultural History of AP

questions.s: During the Kakatiya period, the caste associations were known as:

questions.s: Pedagamjam and Chinaganjam were known for their production of:

questions.s: During the ancient and medieval days, Pradvivaka was an adviser to the king in:

questions.s: Kakatiaya Rudrama had borne the title "Rayagaja Kesari" in Commemoration of her victory over:

questions.s: The musical instrument Jalakaranda can be found mentioned in the inscription of:

questions.s: Who among the following presidents of India has functioned as the speaker of Lok Sabha:
questions.x: Neelam Sanjiva Reddy was Lok Sabha Speaker (1967-69, 1977) before becoming President in 1977.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Articles of the Indian Constitution deals with the matters relating to All State Legislature:
questions.x: Chapter III of Part VI, Articles 168 to 212, deals with State Legislatures.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: At present how many States in India are having Legislative Councils:
questions.x: In 2019 seven states had Legislative Councils (AP, Telangana, UP, Bihar, Maharashtra, Karnataka and J&K before reorganisation).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who appoints the Chairman of Finance Commission:
questions.x: Article 280 empowers the President to constitute the Finance Commission and appoint its chairman.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: From which Constitution the concept of concurrent list has borrowed:
questions.x: The Concurrent List was borrowed from the Australian Constitution.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Article of the Constitution declares India shall be a "Union of States":
questions.x: Article 1(1) says India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Constitution of India adopted the Federal System from the Act of:
questions.x: The federal scheme was largely taken from the Government of India Act 1935.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for Co-operation between the States:
questions.x: Article 263 lets the President set up an Inter-State Council to promote coordination between states.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which Committee first suggested Constitutional Status for Panchayati Raj Institutions:
questions.x: The L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986) first recommended constitutional recognition for panchayats.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: How many Municipalities are there in Andhra Pradesh at present:
questions.x: The keyed answer is 71 municipalities in Andhra Pradesh at the time of the exam.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following is an example of Direct Democracy?
questions.x: In the Grama Sabha all voters take part directly, which makes it an example of direct democracy.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the Article provide for the Reservation of seats for the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in Panchayat Raj Institutions:
questions.x: Article 243D provides reservation of seats for SCs, STs and women in panchayats.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s:
Match list-I (Functionaries) with list-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below lists:
List-I (Functionaries) / List-II (Institution)
A. Sarpanch - 1. Municipal Corporation
B. Chairperson - 2. Village Panchayat
C. Mayor - 3. Municipality
D. Councillor - 4. Cantonment Board
5. Ward
questions.x: The Sarpanch heads a village panchayat, a Chairperson a municipality, a Mayor a municipal corporation, and a Councillor represents a ward.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s:
Which of the following Political parties is/are National Political Parties?
1. DMK
2. Revolutionary Socialist Party
3. All India Forward Black
4. Peasants and Workers Party of India
Choose the correct answer from the codes given below codes:
questions.x: None of the four is a recognised national party; they are state or unrecognised parties.

questions.s: On which date National Unity Day is celebrated in India?
questions.x: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas is observed on 31 October, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birthday.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who appoints the Chairman and Members of National Commission for minorities?
questions.x: Under the NCM Act 1992 the Central Government nominates the chairperson and members.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following State in India first establish the Lokayuktha?
questions.x: Maharashtra set up the first Lokayukta in 1971; APPSC's revised key gives this answer.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following subject comes under the Central Government:
questions.x: Banking is entry 45 of the Union List.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: If the State fail to carry out directives of the Union Government, the President can-
questions.answer: impose president rule on the State
questions.x: Under Article 365, failure to comply with Union directions lets the President hold that the state government cannot be carried on, so Article 356 can be used.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The main objective of the National Development Council is
questions.answer:
1. To promote Common Economic policies in all vital spheres
2. To strengthen and mobilise the efforts and resources of the Nation in support of the Plan
3. To ensure balanced and rapid development of all parties of the country
(All the three options)
questions.x: The NDC (1952) was set up for all three of these aims; APPSC's revised key accepts all three.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Pradhan Manthri Ujjwala Yojana Schemes is meant for
questions.x: PMUY (2016) gives free LPG connections to women of poor households.
questions.subject: Indian Society

questions.s: What are the rational aspects of Right to Information Act?
questions.x: The RTI Act 2005 aims at transparency, accountability and checking corruption, so all the listed aims apply.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: When was the National Anthem officially adopted by the Constituent assembly as the Indian National anthem.
questions.x: The Constituent Assembly adopted Jana Gana Mana as the national anthem on 24 January 1950.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who was the first Loka Ayukta of Integrated State of Andhra Pradesh
questions.x: Justice Avula Sambasiva Rao was the first Lokayukta of Andhra Pradesh (1983).
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which of the following is not a fundamental right?
questions.x: The right to work is a Directive Principle (Article 41), not a Fundamental Right.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Preamble is a part of the Constitution and relates to its basic structure Frame work was held in
questions.answer: Kesavananda Bharati v State of Kerala.
questions.x: In Kesavananda Bharati (1973) the Supreme Court held the Preamble to be part of the Constitution and laid down the basic structure doctrine.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The chief source of political power in India is
questions.x: The Preamble begins 'We, the people of India', making the people the source of authority.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: A law is void only to the extent of inconsistency with fundamental rights and if that part is severable, the law remains valid and alive which is consistent with fundamental rights. This doctrine is
questions.x: Under Article 13, only the offending part of a law is void if it can be severed; this is the doctrine of severability.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: "Right to life" does not include "right to die". It has been held in case of
questions.answer: Chenna Jagadeswar v. State of A.P.
questions.x: In Chenna Jagadeeswar v. State of AP (1988) the AP High Court held that Article 21 does not include a right to die.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Article 23 of the Indian Constitution prohibits
questions.answer: traffic in human beings and forced labour.
questions.x: Article 23 bans trafficking in human beings, begar and other forced labour.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Compelling to incriminate himself in a case is
questions.x: Article 20(3) protects an accused from being compelled to be a witness against himself, i.e. self-incrimination.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: High Court judge holds office until they attain the age of
questions.x: Under Article 217 a High Court judge holds office until 62 years of age.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The officers of the State Legislative Assembly are
questions.x: The Speaker (with the Deputy Speaker) is the presiding officer of the Legislative Assembly.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Delegated legislation means that
questions.answer: the exercise of power of rule - making is delegated to executive by the legislature.
questions.x: Delegated legislation is rule-making by the executive under powers given to it by a statute.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Chairman and other members of Union Public Service Commission shall be appointed by
questions.x: Article 316 says the Chairman and members of the UPSC are appointed by the President.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Rajmannar committee was setup by Tamilnadu government to
questions.answer: Study the Centre and State relations.
questions.x: The Rajamannar Committee (1969) was set up by Tamil Nadu to examine Centre-State relations.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution
